description: Run one read-only SQL SELECT (alasql dialect: JOIN, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, UNION, WITH, subqueries, CASE, SUM/COUNT/AVG/MIN/MAX/MEDIAN/STDEV, string and date functions) over one or more tables. Each table is { name, file | csv | json }: a local path or base64 of a CSV, TSV, JSON array, JSONL or .xlsx (first sheet, or "sheet"), or inline CSV text / JSON rows. CSV cells are typed (numbers, true/false, empty → null; ISO dates stay ISO text, so they sort and compare correctly; YEAR()/MONTH() work on them). Only SELECT is allowed: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DROP/CREATE/ALTER/ATTACH, SELECT INTO, file readers like FROM CSV(...), inline JavaScript and the -> operator are refused. Table names are case-sensitive; quote odd column names and reserved words (total, value, count, date…) as [My Column]. Returns columns and up to maxRows rows (default 500) with the total count; set "output" (.csv, .tsv, .json, .jsonl or .xlsx) to save every row to a file. Runs locally; nothing is uploaded.

maxRows.description: Rows to return inline (default 500). "total" always counts all rows.

output.description: Optional: save ALL result rows to this file; the type comes from the extension (.csv, .tsv, .json, .jsonl, .xlsx; default .csv).

query.description: One SELECT statement, e.g. SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC

tables.description: The tables the query can read (1-20).

csv.description: Or: CSV/TSV text inline (delimiter detected; first row is the header).

file.description: A table file: local path (absolute, or relative to --root) or base64. CSV, TSV, JSON array, JSONL or .xlsx.

format.description: Force the file format (default "auto": by extension, then by content).

json.description: Or: JSON inline: an array of objects (or of arrays, first one the header), as a value or as JSON/JSONL text.

name.description: Table name used in the query.

sheet.description: For .xlsx: the sheet name to read (default: the first sheet).

types.description: Type CSV cells (numbers, booleans, null). Default true; false keeps every CSV cell as text.

name: ai_sql_query
title: SQL query over tables
